Memory is written by Claude Code's auto memory, not by instruction. Agents
are told only what their memory is for; Claude Code's own memory
instructions (injected when `memory:` is set, or for the main session's auto
memory) decide what gets written and how. The dreamer normalizes afterwards.

Memory roots, all with the same layers:

- `agent-memory/<agent>/` — a subagent's auto memory (`memory: user`).
- `agent-memory/_main/<project>/` — the default agent's memory: what a
  context with no agent definition (a vanilla session, a fork) learns in one
  project, keyed by project and relocated there by `autoMemoryDirectory` in
  that project's `.claude/settings.json`. Memory belongs to the definition a
  context runs under, not to "main vs subagent"; a subagent without
  `memory:` has none.
- `agent-memory/_user/` — facts about the person. No native mechanism writes
  here; promote routes notes to it, and its index is injected into every
  session and mirrored into agent indexes.

Where auto memory is off (cloud VMs), the indexes are injected at
SessionStart and agents carry a pointer to read their own; what they write
on the VM travels as `memory-outbox/` on the project's transcripts branch
and the settle phase applies it here.

Outbox rules (settle, Step 0):
- A note applied from an outbox was written by the agent itself:
  `origin: note`, whatever frontmatter the writer gave it (writers never
  set `status`/`origin`; a value outside the sets below, such as
  `user-stated` or `user`, becomes `status: bet`, `origin: note`). A user
  turn that states the same claim confirms it (`status: confirmed`, origin
  stays `note`); it is a prior note, so it is never re-filed as
  `origin: filed`. Routing it to another root moves it with its origin.

  same list as transcript files, as its directory
  `tx/<slug>/<session>/memory-outbox`. No other key (`outboxes_consumed`
  is obsolete).

(`debugging.md`, `conventions.md`, ...). The dreamer treats every file that is
not `MEMORY.md` and not under `wiki/` as layer 1, whatever it is called, and
adds `wiki/`, `issues.md` and `dream-log.md` beside them.

Three layers. Only the dreamer writes layers 2 and 3.

Written by auto memory while working, in whatever shape it chooses. The
dreamer (settle phase) owns the frontmatter and may split a topic file that
holds several claims into `notes/<slug>.md`, leaving a link behind.

```markdown

status: bet            # bet | confirmed | corrected | retired
origin: note           # note: the agent wrote it at the moment (a real bet)
                       # transcript: the agent only said it; settle wrote the note
                       # filed: a user statement with no prior bet; a record, not a settlement
project: ai-lab-sleep-project
made: 2026-11-10       # when the belief was held (the turn's time, for origin: transcript)
settled:               # date, by settle
evidence:              # locators, filled by settle (grammar below)
  - transcripts/ai-lab-sleep-project/<session>/main.jsonl#<uuid>  # "the quoted turn"
  - knowledge/descaling.md#schedule
---

  `bet` of `origin: note` by definition.

  writers file their bets or the dreamer has to recover them.

Every `evidence:` entry points at one place a script can open again. A YAML
comment after it may carry a short quote for the reader.

| form | points at |
|---|---|
| `transcripts/<slug>/<session>/main.jsonl#<uuid>` | one record of the user's session (`uuid` field) |
| `transcripts/<slug>/<session>/subagents/<file>.jsonl#<uuid>` | one record of an agent run |

An open bet carries a `## Dossier` section at the end of its body, generated
by `scripts/bet-dossier.py <note> --write` (settle runs it for every `bet`
and replaces the previous dossier). It is the case file a human — or the
dreamer — decides from: a dated timeline (the note, each cited turn, each
change of the cited file lines, each related note), the cited turn with the
turn before it, `git log -L` of the cited lines at the project's
`origin/main`, and the related notes' claims. What is still missing goes in
the note body under `## Open`, above the dossier, where regeneration cannot
erase it. Everything above `## Dossier` is the note; the dossier is derived
and replaced on every settle.

## L2 — wiki (`wiki/<topic>.md`)

Written only by the relate phase. One subject per page, abstracted from notes,
never copying a transcript. Links down to the notes it rests on and across to
related pages with `[[wiki/<topic>]]` / `[[notes/<slug>]]`. Obsidian renders
these links and the graph; nothing else is needed to navigate.

Auto memory creates and curates this file itself; the promote phase rewrites

out as a proposal under the project's `.claude/rules/` (PR), not here.

  line per issue: `- [ ] <date> <note or wiki path>: <what's wrong, and what evidence would settle it>`.
